provenance.notes: KIT: no servo in the SunFounder Basic Starter Kit table of contents or Component List photo, so 'not in kit'. PIN ORDER AND COLOURS: SunFounder SG90 page 'Pinout': brown wire GND, orange wire signal (PWM pin), red wire VCC; the compiled datasheet says 'Red = Battery(+) Brown = Battery(-) Orange = Signal'. The order brown, red, orange is the standard servo plug order. CONNECTOR: the SunFounder photo shows the wires ending in a black 3-position plastic housing that takes pins (a female socket), and the TowerPro page calls it a 'JR (Fits JR and Futaba)' plug; the compiled datasheet calls it the universal 'S' type connector. A female housing mates with a male-male lead, matching SPEC 6.5. SUPPLY: the SG90 data sheet block says 'Operating voltage: 4.8 V (~5V)'; the TowerPro page (SG90 Digital variant) says 4.8 V and its reply to a customer says '4.8V - 6V are fine'; servodatabase says 4.8-6 V. A second block in the compiled PDF (another vendor's text) says 4.0-7.2 V and the 1.2 kgf-cm / 0.12 s figures: conflict, the SG90 data sheet block is followed with 6 V as the upper limit. SPEED AND TORQUE: data sheet block 0.1 s/60 deg and 1.8 kgf-cm at 4.8 V; TowerPro page 0.1 s/60 deg and 1.8 kg-cm at 4.8 V; servodatabase says 0.12 s/60 deg at 4.8 V and 0.10 s at 6 V, 25 oz-in (1.8 kgf-cm) at 4.8 V. PWM: the SunFounder page says the servo expects a pulse every 20 ms and 1.5 ms is neutral; the SG90 data sheet block says 1.5 ms is the middle (0 deg), about 2 ms is all the way to one side (+90) and about 1 ms is all the way to the other (-90), with about 180 deg of travel; these three pulses are used for the angle map. CONFLICT: the compiled datasheet and servodatabase list pulse width 500-2400 us with a 20 ms cycle and 180 deg, SunFounder says 'about 0.5 ms ~ 2.5 ms', and the TowerPro reply says its normal servos operate 0-150 deg unless sold as 180 or 360; if 500-2400 us spans 180 deg the 1 ms and 2 ms points would not be at +-90, so the pulse limits are kept as pulseLimitMinUs and pulseLimitMaxUs and the +-90 map is the datasheet statement. Dead band 10 us in the data sheet block (TowerPro digital page says 1 us). CURRENT: servodatabase lists 10 mA idle, 100 mA running at 4.8 V (250 mA at 6 V) and 360-700 mA stall; the TowerPro reply says 'operation current for our SG90 is about 0.5A - 2A'. No manufacturer datasheet gives a no-load or stall current, so these are a third-party database value and are unverified against a manufacturer. NOT VERIFIED: the signal-pin logic threshold (no opened source states it). SIZE: data sheet drawing 22.2 body x 11.8 wide, 32.2 over the mounting ears, 31 overall height (the TowerPro page lists 23 x 12.2 x 29 mm for the digital variant; servodatabase 23.0 x 12.2 x 29.0). Cable length: the compiled datasheet says 248 mm, TowerPro says 25 cm; 250 mm is used.
